meta.title: Check my contract
meta.description: Check a job contract, or a job with no written contract, against Mongolia's Labour Law and get a red, yellow or green result for each rule.

start.title: How would you like to check your job?
start.lead: Pick one of three ways. No sign-in needed.
start.questionnaireBody: If you have no written contract. 15 questions, about 5 minutes.
start.pasteBody: Copy your contract and paste it in.
start.uploadTitle: Add a photo or a file
start.uploadBody: A phone photo, a PDF or a Word file. Photos are read on your phone.
start.privacy: Nothing about you is kept. Unless you choose to save it, it is deleted once your result is shown.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: What the contract checker, the CV check, accounts and the request for help process, who processes it, how long it is kept and how to delete it.
privacy.draft: This notice is a draft that a lawyer has not yet reviewed. It will be finalised after checking it against Mongolia's personal data protection law.

what.title: What is processed
what.body: The text, files and answers you give the contract checker and the CV check are processed in memory, only while your result is worked out. Photos are read on your phone — they never reach our server. Register numbers, phone numbers, emails and account numbers are removed before anything is sent to the AI.

kept.title: What is kept
kept.body: Nothing, unless you choose to save it. The only thing always kept is anonymous counts: rule, result, rule set version, month, age group, job category, employer type and aimag (if you chose one). Names, files, text and contact details never go into the counts. A figure based on fewer than 5 cases is never published.

who.title: Who processes it
who.body: Ajilchin Zugii. The AI that reads contracts and CVs: Google Gemini (USA), which receives the redacted text only. Accounts: Clerk (USA) — your email and sign-in details. Hosting: Vercel or Cloudflare. Encrypted case files: Cloudflare R2.

cases.title: If you ask for help
cases.body: When you ask for help, the contact method you chose and your description are stored encrypted. If you tick "save", the contract text (without your register number) is stored encrypted too. Only Ajilchin Zugii caseworkers can open it, and every time they do is logged.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.body: A case file is deleted automatically after 90 days or when the case closes, whichever comes first. Account data is kept until you delete it.

deletion.title: How to delete it
deletion.body: When a case is opened, we email you a link to delete it. Your account page has a "Delete my account and data" button that deletes your account, saved results and linked cases.

minors.title: If you are under 18
minors.body: Under 13 there is no account, but the tools work without one. At 13–17, creating an account or saving anything needs a parent or guardian’s consent, and the time of consent is recorded.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: If you have a question, write to the email address at the bottom of the site.
